{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend structured coat, tailored straight cut reaching mid-calf, charcoal gray (#384042), heavy wool blend.
Thermal turtleneck knit sweater, relaxed fit with long sleeves, soft cream (#F5F5DC), fine gauge merino wool.
Slim-fit dark denim trousers, straight leg, deep indigo (#191970), durable cotton twill.
Waterproof leather ankle boots, rounded toe with low block heel, matte black (#2F4F4F) to repel wet snow.
This outfit works because the heavy wool coat and waterproof boots provide essential protection against freezing temperatures and slushy roads during your twenty-minute walk. The layered thermal sweater ensures you stay warm under the coat without bulk, allowing for comfortable movement while walking in snow. Finally, the dark denim trousers offer a neat, professional appearance suitable for an office environment that remains practical enough for wintry conditions."}
